description.text: The major of Environmental Science mainly teaches the basic theories and knowledge of environmental science, aiming to cultivate high-quality specialized talents with the concept of sustainable development, who possess the basic theories, knowledge and skills of environmental science and engineering, and master the specialized knowledge of related fields.

duration.text: The Environmental Science at Northwest University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5208 USD/per year ￥ 37500 CNY/per year
